content: Secondly, we perform the principal component analysis (PCA) method to reduce the dimensionality. It captures latent meanings and takes into account high-order cooccurrence removing noise. The attribute (column) number of the matrix is reduced to 200. We then compute cosine similarity between each row pair $w_i$ and $w_j$ as in (DISPLAY_FORM3) to find out how similar two word vectors (rows) are.
